title: Tourify Custom Post Styles
objective: Allow every authorized Tourify author to style each authored post with the shared Artist EPK templates and approved editor controls without changing the surrounding feed or other authors' posts.

phases.name: Audit and baseline

tasks.title: Read repository instructions and map architecture
tasks.completion_gate: All applicable AGENTS.md and project instructions are recorded with the canonical application paths.

tasks.title: Inventory EPK templates and editor
tasks.completion_gate: Every template ID, alias, lifecycle, version, control, asset, persistence field, and renderer is represented in the audit and parity matrix.

tasks.title: Inventory post creation and rendering surfaces
tasks.completion_gate: Every authoring action, canonical type/query/serializer, and viewer or operational renderer is classified.

tasks.title: Audit ownership, RLS, flags, cache, drafts, revisions, moderation, and analytics
tasks.completion_gate: Existing canonical patterns and risks are documented with exact paths.

tasks.title: Capture EPK and legacy post baselines
tasks.completion_gate: Reproducible visual and performance baselines exist for desktop and mobile.

tasks.title: Reconcile plan with repository
tasks.completion_gate: Implementation JSON contains actual paths, commands, dependencies, owners, and gates; all architecture deviations are recorded.

phases.phase_gate: No EPK template, editor path, post render surface, or authorization path remains unknown.

phases.name: Shared appearance foundation

tasks.title: Create typed versioned appearance contracts
tasks.completion_gate: Schema, template, token, asset, lifecycle, entitlement, and surface-capability types have runtime and compile-time validation.

tasks.title: Centralize registry and alias resolution
tasks.completion_gate: EPK and future post adapters consume one registry; uniqueness and alias tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement sanitizer, compiler, migration, and fallback
tasks.completion_gate: Semantic tokens compile deterministically; unsafe/invalid inputs fail to documented reason codes.

tasks.title: Migrate EPK consumption without visual change
tasks.completion_gate: All existing EPK functional and visual tests pass with no unapproved visual diff.

phases.phase_gate: Shared appearance code is in use by EPK while EPK output and stored data remain compatible.

phases.name: Data, RLS, services, and DTO

tasks.title: Add additive schema and RLS
tasks.completion_gate: Profile, appearance, draft/revision support, constraints, indexes, and tested RLS exist without modifying legacy rows.

tasks.title: Implement profile CRUD and default transaction
tasks.completion_gate: Authorized owners can manage profiles and concurrent updates cannot create multiple active defaults.

tasks.title: Implement preview and publish snapshot services
tasks.completion_gate: Preview and publish use the same server-authoritative resolver; post and appearance publish atomically.

tasks.title: Extend canonical post DTO and cache keys
tasks.completion_gate: All consumers can receive styled or standard appearance without per-post fetches, and cache keys include appearance revision/hash.

tasks.title: Add verification and negative authorization tests
tasks.completion_gate: Cross-user and cross-account references fail; data integrity queries return no unexpected rows.

phases.phase_gate: Backend supports safe styled-post publication and reading while flags-off behavior remains unchanged.

phases.name: One-template vertical slice

tasks.title: Build isolated post style boundary
tasks.completion_gate: Computed-style sentinel and forbidden-selector tests prove no leakage outside the post root.

tasks.title: Build semantic post regions and standard fallback
tasks.completion_gate: All current content/actions render and one post failure cannot crash the feed.

tasks.title: Implement one template feed/detail adapter
tasks.completion_gate: Representative template renders in feed and permalink with responsive fixtures.

tasks.title: Implement compose preview publish flow
tasks.completion_gate: An authorized author can select, preview, publish, and view the same sanitized style end to end.

tasks.title: Measure vertical slice
tasks.completion_gate: No hydration warnings and performance remains within documented launch guardrails.

phases.phase_gate: The one-template vertical slice passes functional, isolation, regression, and performance tests.

phases.name: Shared editor and style profiles

tasks.title: Share schema-driven EPK editor controls
tasks.completion_gate: Controls are reused by EPK and post modes with a documented capability state for every control.

tasks.title: Build registry-driven template gallery and previews
tasks.completion_gate: Gallery and deterministic thumbnails come from the registry and use the production post renderer.

tasks.title: Build saved/default style management
tasks.completion_gate: Create, rename, duplicate, edit, archive, and one-default flows pass for every posting account type.

tasks.title: Build per-post overrides and reusable-save flow
tasks.completion_gate: A one-post customization does not mutate its source profile and may be deliberately saved as a new profile.

tasks.title: Complete draft recovery and accessible authoring
tasks.completion_gate: Refresh/offline recovery, keyboard, screen reader, contrast, reduced-motion, and field-error behaviors pass.

phases.phase_gate: Authors can use the shared EPK tools to manage reusable and per-post appearances with preview/publish parity.

phases.name: All template adapters

tasks.title: Implement every active template adapter
tasks.completion_gate: Every active template supports required feed/detail variants or is blocked by an explicit product decision.

tasks.title: Implement alias and lifecycle behavior
tasks.completion_gate: Legacy aliases, retired historical posts, disabled fallbacks, and new-selection rules pass.

tasks.title: Complete template fixtures and visual tests
tasks.completion_gate: Every template passes content-type, mobile/desktop, accessibility, asset-missing, and nested-style fixtures.

phases.phase_gate: The EPK-to-post parity matrix has no unresolved active template.

phases.name: All audited post surfaces

tasks.title: Integrate core viewer surfaces
tasks.completion_gate: Home/following, own feed, public profile, permalink, and quote/repost use the canonical renderer.

tasks.title: Integrate secondary viewer surfaces
tasks.completion_gate: Groups, discovery/search, event/tour/community feeds and every audit-discovered viewer surface are classified and implemented.

tasks.title: Classify compact and operational surfaces
tasks.completion_gate: Notifications, moderation, embeds, and link previews have approved full, compact, neutral, or intentionally unstyled behavior.

tasks.title: Verify cache and privacy transitions
tasks.completion_gate: Appearance edits, post visibility changes, blocks, and deletion invalidate all relevant output without cross-user leakage.

phases.phase_gate: The render-surface inventory has no unresolved row and equivalent viewer surfaces show one canonical appearance.

phases.name: Hardening and release

tasks.title: Complete security and abuse testing
tasks.completion_gate: RLS matrix, fuzzing, injection, asset, deception, race, and moderation tests have no unresolved critical/high finding.

tasks.title: Complete accessibility testing
tasks.completion_gate: WCAG AA, keyboard, screen reader, zoom, reduced motion, and forced-color checks pass.

tasks.title: Complete performance optimization
tasks.completion_gate: Mixed-template feed meets platform baselines and documented launch guardrails on representative mobile conditions.

tasks.title: Complete regression suite and observability
tasks.completion_gate: EPK, legacy post, sharing, moderation, analytics, and viewer regressions pass; dashboards and alerts exist.

tasks.title: Rehearse rollback and stage rollout
tasks.completion_gate: Flags restore standard rendering without data loss; controlled cohort rollout and stop conditions are documented.

phases.phase_gate: All mandatory product, design, data, security, accessibility, performance, regression, observability, and rollback evidence is approved.

global_completion_gates: Existing EPKs render identically after shared-code extraction.
Styles never escape the authored post boundary.
All active EPK templates have verified post adapters or an explicit approved exception.
Home feed, author feed, public profile, and permalink show the same canonical post appearance.
Legacy and unstyled posts remain unchanged.
Server authorization and RLS prevent cross-user and cross-account style use.
Invalid or unsafe appearance data falls back per post without feed failure.
Mixed-style feed meets accessibility and performance budgets.
Feature flags and rollback are tested without deleting stored appearance data.
